name: Camping Stein
beschreibung: Camping Stein is located in Bad Endorf in the Chiemgau. The site is nestled in a park-like landscape. It offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. Its own lake with swimming opportunities is part of the facility. The infrastructure includes a restaurant and a kiosk. From here, excursions to Chiemsee and into the mountains are possible. The region is known for its thermal springs.
